name: exists_seq_forall_proj_of_forall_finite
statement: ℕ → Type*} [Finite (α 0)] [∀ i, Nonempty (α i)] (π : {i j : ℕ} → (hij : i ≤ j) → α j → α i) (π_refl : ∀ ⦃i⦄ (a : α i), π rfl.le a = a) (π_trans : ∀ ⦃i j k⦄ (hij : i ≤ j) (hjk : j ≤ k) a, π hij (π hjk a) = π (hij.trans hjk) a) (hfin : ∀ i a, {b : α (i+1) | π (Nat.le_add_right i 1) b = a}.Finite) : ∃ f : (i : ℕ) → α i, ∀ ⦃i j⦄ (hij : i ≤ j), π hij (f j) = f i
